name: desktop
description: The desktop surface: every office role from its spec, in an Electrobun window.

scripts.deps: BUN_INSTALL_GLOBAL_DIR="$(cd ../../../engine/bun && pwd)/.bun" bun install --frozen-lockfile && bun run --cwd native deps
scripts.check: bun tools/compile.ts && tsc -p . && bun tools/analyze.ts && bun run --cwd native typecheck
scripts.lint: biome ci . && bun run --cwd native check
scripts.test: bun test ./tests && bun run --cwd native test
scripts.app: bun tools/build.ts && bun run --cwd native app
scripts.audit: bun audit --audit-level=low && bun run --cwd native audit
scripts.gate: bun run deps && bun run check && bun run lint && bun run test && bun run build && bun run audit
